info.name: FraudDetection App API
info.description:
Used by the FraudDetection web app for Fraud Analysts, Supervisors, Head of Fraud,
IT Admins and Auditors. Every request runs inside one operator (tenant), taken from
the access token. Records of another operator return 404.

Conventions
- JSON, snake_case keys, UTF-8.
- Times are ISO 8601 with offset. Ghana is UTC+0.
- Money is integer minor units plus currency (GHS 18,400 = 1840000).
- Subscriber identifiers are masked by default. Use POST /subscribers/{subscriber_id}/reveal.
- Lists use cursor pagination, newest first.
- Every POST that changes state accepts an Idempotency-Key header, kept 24 hours.
- Updates need If-Match with the ETag from the last read; a stale ETag returns 409.
- Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457) with a stable `code`.

Draft 0.1, 25 Oct 2026, derived from the Figma screens. See the API documentation
for the screen map and open questions.


Contact Support:
 Name: FraudDetection product team
